newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco arrests two Dutchmen on drug charges.
newsitem.headline: Morocco arrests two Dutchmen on drug charges.

text.p: Two Dutchmen will appear in a Moroccan court on July 22 after being charged with drug trafficking, a Dutch embassy spokesman said on Thursday.
The two men, identified as Johan Dolman, 58, and Alexandre Godefredes Bernardes Van Zon, 40, were arrested at Casablanca port earlier this month. They will appear in court in the city of Casablanca.
Police said they were found to be carrying 31 kg (68 pounds) of cannabis.
The embassy spokesman declined to say from which area the two came from or any other details.
